description: Genius bee with wild hair! Discovered the theory of Bee-lativity.
Crowned and cool! The royal burger bee of the spelling kingdom.
A peaceful little bee who loves calm vibes, focus, and mindful spelling moments.
Always buzzing with energy and enthusiasm!
Adorable and sweet — Cutie Bee is guaranteed to make every game session extra fun.
The Bee-yoncé of the hive! Born to spell, born to shine!
Dr. Bee is always here to help! Clipboard ready, cheering you on as you learn new words.
Fairy dust and spelling magic! Wings ready for word adventures.
Putting out fires and spelling words! Flame-resistant hero of the hive.
Created by Dr. Franken-sting! Spells by lightning power.
Headset on and controller ready — Gamer Bee is locked in for spelling victory!
Sweet, golden, and iconic — Honey Comb Bee represents pure BeeSmart pride.
A brilliant spark-powered genius — Inventor Bee creates buzzing new ideas with electricity!
Ready to rock n' roll! Guitar in hand, J Rock Bee brings rhythm to your spelling.
Brave and noble! Defender of the hive.
Strong, brave, and outdoorsy — Lumberjack Bee chops through tough spelling challenges!
Fast and focused, Motor Bee zooms into action and powers up your learning.
Caring, kind, and always helpful — Nurse Bee cheers you on to stay healthy and keep spelling strong!
A classic BeeSmart sidekick — O Bee keeps things simple, fun, and full of charm.
Fixing leaks and spelling streaks! Plumber Bee is ready to unclog tricky words.
Wise and knowledgeable! The scholarly bee.
Royal and majestic! Leader with grace.
Buzzbot 3000! Honey-powered circuits.
Rock and roll! Lead singer of The Bee-tles.
A deep-sea explorer bee who loves ocean adventures and cool blue vibes.
Say cheese! Always ready for the perfect selfie!
Microphone ready — Singer Bee hits every high note as you hit every correct word!
Out-of-this-world awesome! Space Bee is ready for spelling missions across the galaxy.
Saving the day with bee powers! Cape included.
Glowing neon armor and futuristic style — Techno Bee is powered by pure brain energy!
You're SAFE! Umpire Bee calls the plays and keeps every spelling game fair and fun.
Count Bee-cula! I vant to spell your vords!
Were-bee of London! Howls at the full moon.

Chilly, fluffy, and super friendly — Yeti Bee brings cool fun to your spelling adventure!
The Walking Buzzed! Craves brainy words.
